body.name: Compatible-prefix approximation and testing handle
body.construction: Starting from the centered functional \(G_{T,c}\), partition unconditional subtree-root masses into dyadic occupancy ranges, approximate each rational descendant contribution by a polynomial in unconditional child masses subject to the parent-sum identities, lift monomials by multinomial factorial moments or degenerate \(U\)-statistics with covariance retained for nested prefixes, and construct dual moment-matched priors by drawing whole legal subtrees rather than independent prefix counts.
